column4: Splash/menu composer: writes a glyph-index grid (e.g. 23x27 cells) into font-select SRAM (3-byte OSD word writer bank6:0x65d1 via port 0x92; row cmd bank6:0x6530), computes font_base, calls osd_set_font_bases (bank6:0x504d), sets window words + OSD scale 0x3A0A. docs/boot-logo.md.
Font-download orient/rotation (0x3A0B), writes 0x3A18, enables OSD via 0x3A02[0] (osd_enable_set bank6:0x5e35). Paired with osd_compose_glyph_grid_map. docs/boot-logo.md.
Splash/menu composer call site (caller of thunk 0x106b -> bank6:0x4272); pairs b0f4 map (23x27). Which site is the power-on splash not isolated statically.
Splash/menu composer call site (caller of thunk 0x106b); pairs b0f4 map (24x18).
Glyph-set descriptors seeding the banked far pointer (bank=SFR 0xFFFF, offset E1E8:E1E9) that bank6:0x4272 reads glyph data from. 00 08 00 00 ... c0 ff 00 09 11 98 f1 60. docs/boot-logo.md.
